cover.coreProposition: Reconstructed message role is not sufficient authority provenance: original principal, origin channel, privilege class and any trusted privilege transition must remain independently inspectable across persistence, summarization, handoff and context reconstruction.
cover.visualMetaphor: A paper seal keeps its original small imprint while passing through enlarging translucent frames
cover.semanticObject: One provenance seal traveling through layered context frames without changing its source mark
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover centered on a persistent origin seal, with surrounding layers changing scale but not the seal identity
